parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, this is Greenfield Pharmacy. How can I assist you?

Hi, I'm calling to check some details before I start my new job there. I was given a few notes, but I just want to confirm them.

Of course. Our manager, John Field, is available if you need further clarification.

Great. I also need to save the pharmacy's contact number. Can you tell me?

Certainly. It's 0491570159.

Got it. Now, regarding my shifts, I was told that I start quite early in the morning.

Yes, most of our employees begin their shifts before the store opens. Your shift starts at 7.45 am. That way, you'll have time to prepare for the first customers.

All right. I also heard there's one late night opening each week.

That's correct. The store stays open late on Friday evenings. It's usually our busiest night, so we need all hands on deck.

Good to know. And my official start date?

You'll be starting from the 22nd of January. So be sure to arrive a little early on your first day to complete any remaining paperwork.

Thanks. Also, I remember something about uniforms. Should I bring my own?

No. That won't be necessary. We provide staff with a uniform, and Barbara will assist you in getting the right size.

All right. And I believe John is going to email me about another matter.

Yes, he'll send you some details about parking, including where you can leave your vehicle and the space is allocated for staff members.

Perfect.

Now, about the facilities. I recall there’s a machine available for customers to use, right?

Yes, we have a weight machine near the entrance. Customers often use it to check their body weight. Just ensure that it’s functioning properly at all times.

Will do. If a customer needs medical assistance, who should they speak to?

We always have a nurse on duty so they can approach the counter and ask for help if necessary.

Got it. And I should be careful when lifting heavy stock, right?

Absolutely. We store some large boxes at the back, and if they aren’t lifted correctly, you might injure your back. So, make sure to bend your knees and avoid straining yourself.

That makes sense. Oh, one last thing. I heard that the store has introduced new bags. What do they look like?

Yes, we’ve recently switched to a more eco-friendly option. They now come in purple, so they’re easy to spot.

That’s helpful. Thanks for all the information.

analyses.content: 咨询者要求保存药房的联系电话，工作人员报出的号码是 0491570159。
I also need to save the pharmacy's contact number. Can you tell me? Certainly. It's 0491570159。
听到 contact number 后定位。虽然题目问的是 John's phone number，但在 Part 1 对话中，药房的号码即被视为联系经理的途径。
Yes, most of our employees begin their shifts before the store opens. Your shift starts at 7.45 am。
听到 shift starts 后捕捉时间点。注意雅思听力中时间点的书写格式，点号（.）或冒号（:）均可接受。
员工的班次早于营业时间开始，具体时间为早上 7.45，以便为第一批顾客做准备。
That's correct. The store stays open late on Friday evenings. It's usually our busiest night, so we need all hands on deck。
听到 late night opening 后定位。录音解释了这是最忙的一晚（busiest night），所以全员在岗。
药房每周有一个晚上会延长营业，这个时间固定在 Friday（周五）晚上。
And my official start date? You'll be starting from the 22nd of January。
听到 start date 定位。由于题目要求填入一个单词/数字，写成 22 January 符合要求。
咨询者的正式入职日期被定在 22nd of January（1月22日）。
We provide staff with a uniform, and Barbara will assist you in getting the right size。
否定排除干扰。录音明确说了 No，表示不需要 bring your own，而填入药房提供的 uniform。
员工不需要自带衣服，药房会提供一套 uniform（制服），由 Barbara 协助挑选尺码。
经理 John 稍后会发邮件详细告知关于 parking（停车）及员工专属车位的信息。
Yes, he'll send you some details about parking, including where you can leave your vehicle and the space is allocated for staff members。
听到 John is going to email 后定位。捕捉 details about... 后面的核心名词。
Yes, we have a weight machine near the entrance. Customers often use it to check their body weight。
听到 machine 定位。卷面已给出 machine，因此只需填写修饰语 weight。注意原文提到了 check their body weight 作为提示。
药房门口有一台 weight machine（体重计），供顾客检查身体重量。
We always have a nurse on duty so they can approach the counter and ask for help if necessary。
听到 medical assistance 或 health concerns 后定位。寻找 on duty 之前修饰的人员身份。
如果顾客有医疗咨询需求，药房一直有一名 nurse（护士）在岗值班。
Absolutely. We store some large boxes at the back, and if they aren’t lifted correctly, you might injure your back。
安全警告定位。听到 heavy stock 或 lifting 时，留意表示身体部位的名词。
工作人员提醒在搬运重物时要小心，如果姿势不正确可能会伤到 back（背部）。
Yes, we’ve recently switched to a more eco-friendly option. They now come in purple, so they’re easy to spot。
听到 new bags 定位颜色。录音通过 eco-friendly 进行了铺垫，随后给出了具体颜色。
药房新推出的环保购物袋是 purple（紫色）的，非常容易识别。
